messages:
maria-ops: quick sync — i'm scheduling the rate-limit cutover tomorrow 09:00 UTC. plan: reduce per-api-key burst from 100r/s -> 60r/s and tighten ephemeral token window. rolling 10% canary for 30m, then 50% for 15m, then full.
ajay: ok. do we have a list of customers that need an exception? dedicated customers should be untouched but double-checking.
paul-support: FYI ACME had noisy retries during their sim test last week. they were hitting 429s when they spiked; they might request a temporary exemption.
jen-ml: suggestion — enable a short smoothing window and prefix caching for long-chat flows to avoid immediate 429s. also route embeddings traffic to a separate lower-burst bucket if possible.
sam-runtime: we should exempt internal probes and the autoscaler tokens. otherwise we'll see false-positive health failures.
maria-ops: agreed. i'll add route_exempt: ["/health","/metrics","/internal/*"] and allow token-role=autoscaler.
paul-support: one more: billing team reported a webhook retry storm last month that drove retries and inflated token usage. if we clamp too hard, some webhooks will backoff and pile up elsewhere.
jen-ml: good point. recommend we add a traffic-shaping policy for webhook callers: max_concurrent=5, exponential_backoff=true.
maria-ops: working on the canary manifest now — dropping here so eng-runtime can review.

```yaml
# canary-rate-rollout.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: RatePolicy
metadata:
  name: per-key-burst-cutover
spec:
  targets:
    - pathPrefix: "/v1/generate"
      percent: 10
  limits:
    per_key_burst: 60
    sustained_rps: 20
  exemptions:
    - path: "/health"
    - role: "autoscaler"
  duration: 30m
```

sam-runtime: lgtm but add a debug header so we can trace which policy applied: x-rate-policy: per-key-burst-cutover-canary.
ajay: what about rollback criteria? define clear SLO triggers (errors, p50/p95 latency, billing anomalies).
maria-ops: rollback triggers:
- 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m
- 429 rate > 1% for 10m for non-burst endpoints
- sustained customer complaints > 3 in 30m
- billing webhook retry rate > 2x baseline
if any breach, immediate rollback to previous policy and throttle to 80% of current.
paul-support: please add a quick repro snippet for support to use when customers call in.

paul-support: repro snippet:
```
# simulate burst with 10 concurrent clients
for i in {1..10}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate" -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":64}' &
done
wait
# expected: 200s until burst window exhausted, then some 429s
```

maria-ops: deploy-bot — create canary rollout now (10%).
deploy-bot: starting canary rollout per request by maria-ops — id canary-2436789012 — 10% traffic. monitoring hooks enabled.

(15m later)

jen-ml: quick check — p95 for /v1/generate rose from 380ms -> 860ms immediately after canary started, but error rate stayed low. could be cache cold start.
sam-runtime: cache warmers are firing now, p95 improving to ~420ms.
paul-support: just fielded first customer note from ACME: they saw a couple of 429s at 09:12 UTC during their load run. they attached curl logs.
maria-ops: rolling forward to 50% only if error delta < thresholds. current error delta 0.2% — under threshold. i'll hold for another 10m and then move to 50%.
ajay: if ACME requests an exception, we can add an allowlist for their key for 1h and monitor.

(40m later)

deploy-bot: canary progressed to 50%.
jen-ml: monitoring shows a small uptick in retries for embedding batch endpoints — those see larger token sizes. recommend keeping embeddings on the previous burst config for now and re-evaluating quantization/packing.
maria-ops: pausing full rollout. will open a follow-up RFC to analyze embeddings traffic shape and propose a separate policy. rollback plan stays ready.
paul-support: i'll notify ACME that we paused and granted them a 1h exception while we analyze.

sam-runtime: action items:
- maria: open RFC for embeddings policy
- jen: run a packing experiment to reduce burst load
- ajay: prepare emergency allowlist playbook
- paul: send bulletin to affected customers

maria-ops: thanks team — this convo will be the ops record. filing post-rollout notes after embeddings analysis. :thumbsup:
